description: Canonical JSON of a block under the string rule agreed for -01 (RFC 8785, Section 3.2.2.2), with RFC 8785 and two non-conforming encodings for comparison; every boundary of the rule; number lexemes

cases.title: ASCII only: all encodings equal
Umlaut and emoji: the non-conforming ASCII-escaped encoding differs
Line feed and U+001F: the non-conforming uppercase-control encoding differs
U+007F (DEL): raw under the rule and in RFC 8785
U+2028 raw, solidus not escaped
NFC: e-acute as U+00E9
NFD: e followed by U+0301
All five short escapes
Number lexeme 1: RFC 8785 form and value as seq
